appDescription: A drowsy-driving prevention app that estimates cabin carbon dioxide from seat occupancy and climate settings, refreshes the cabin air and suggests rest stops ahead.

function.name: VENTILATE_CABIN
function.description: Bring outside air into the cabin for a short time to lower carbon dioxide, then restore the previous climate setting.

function.name: ADD_REST_STOP
function.description: Add the nearest rest area or drowsy-driving shelter ahead on the road as a navigation waypoint.

function.name: REPORT_DROWSINESS
function.description: Record that the driver feels sleepy, then refresh the cabin air, cool the cabin and add the next rest stop as a waypoint.
